default_questions.description: Does this change appear to expand approved scope or modify unrelated surfaces?
Does this change appear to introduce or alter architecture-level structure or boundaries?
Does this change appear to affect authentication or authorization behavior?
Does this change appear to alter a trust boundary or external data flow?
Does this change appear to reduce a security control or validation gate?
Does this change appear to alter a documented public contract or compatibility boundary?
Does this change appear to add a new external runtime, build, or CI dependency?
How strongly does the change warrant human review beyond routine automated checks?
